title: Minimum Ceiling Height
description: Habitable spaces, hallways, bathrooms, toilet rooms, laundries, and corridors shall have a ceiling height of not less than 8 feet (2438 mm).

title: Minimum Corridor Width
description: Corridors shall have a minimum width of not less than 44 inches (1118 mm) where the occupant load is 50 or more.

title: Accessible Route
description: At least one accessible route shall connect accessible buildings, accessible facilities, accessible elements, and accessible spaces that are on the same site.

title: Exit Access Doors
description: The minimum width of exit access doors shall be 36 inches.

title: Fire Alarms
description: Buildings with an occupant load of more than 50 shall have a fire alarm system installed.

title: Natural Light
description: Every habitable room shall be provided with natural light by means of exterior glazed openings (windows). Minimum 10% of floor area.

title: Natural Ventilation
description: Habitable rooms shall be provided with natural ventilation by means of openable exterior openings. Minimum 5% of floor area.

title: Door Swing
description: Doors shall swing in the direction of egress travel where serving a room or area containing an occupant load of 50 or more.

title: Stair Riser and Tread
description: Stair riser heights shall be 7 inches (178 mm) maximum and 4 inches (102 mm) minimum. Tread depths shall be 11 inches (279 mm) minimum.

title: Accessible Bathrooms
description: Where toilet rooms are provided, at least one of each type shall be accessible.

title: Sprinkler Systems
description: An automatic sprinkler system shall be provided throughout all buildings with an occupancy of R-2 (apartments).

title: Exit Signs
description: Exits and exit access doors shall be marked by an approved exit sign readily visible from any direction of egress travel.

title: Guards
description: Guards shall be located along open-sided walking surfaces, including mezzanines, equipment platforms, stairs, ramps and landings that are located more than 30 inches (762 mm) measured vertically to the floor or grade below.

title: Kitchen Sink Installation
description: Each dwelling unit shall be provided with at least one kitchen sink.

title: Fire Department Connection
description: Automatic sprinkler systems shall be provided with a fire department connection (FDC) on the exterior of the building.

title: Envelope Insulation
description: Exterior walls, roofs, and floors shall meet the minimum R-value requirements for thermal insulation.
